entities.name: YIM1 A7TH23
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Vanderwaltozyma polyspora protein YIM1; 362 aa.
Annotated alcohol dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity; lipid droplet and mitochondrial localization; DNA damage response association, all computational evidence ECO:0000501.
Pfam domains ADH_N (PF08240) at residues 31–91 and ADH_zinc_N_2 (PF13602) at residues 207–359. No explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.

entities.name: YIM1 yeast homologs
observations: Saccharomyces cerevisiae YIM1 homologs show 48.8% identity across essentially the full sequence and annotations for lipid-droplet and mitochondrial localization.
